note: DOT Pad corner-PIN centres, TL,TR,BR,BL, in NATIVE image pixels of each JPEG (x right, y down, pixel centres at integers). TL = the pad's top-left pin when the braille text line is at the BOTTOM, so the order follows the pad, not the image. textSide = where the text line lies in the image. pitchPx = mean pin pitch near the field centre.
method: Per corner: (1) a candidate 60x40 lattice was overlaid on 5-pin corner crops at native resolution, upscaled, and inspected by eye: the corner marker must sit on the extreme dot and every lattice position one or more pins outside the field (both directions) must be blank surface; this was checked for all 36 corners, including the washed-out left columns of the hue_handsoff frames. (2) The confirmed corner dot's centre was then measured INDEPENDENTLY of any lattice fit: grayscale, background = 30th percentile of a +/-1.2 pitch window, weights = max(0, I - bg) inside a 0.45 pitch disc, intensity-weighted centroid iterated 4x from the marker (python/cv2, native resolution). Expected measurement noise is ~0.02-0.05 pin; individual pins also wobble by up to ~0.1 pin, which this per-dot centroid includes and a lattice fit averages out.
split: tune = hue_handsoff_*; held-out (never used to set parameters) = hue_oblique_*, PXL_*.
